207:t_002:9.en:
$$赤城$$
「We wish you success in battle!」

207:t_002:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't worry, sir, $$龍之介$$! We'll protect $$第２新東京市$$!」

207:t_002:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, what is the status of $c's ships?」

207:t_002:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They've deployed and are standing by outside this area, but repairs to them and their machines are still incomplete.」

207:t_002:13.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So we'll have to fight with the forces here now...」

207:t_002:14.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「I confirm a distortion in the dimensional boundary.」

207:t_002:15.en:
$$田中司令$$
「A $$時空震動$$ at a time like this?!」

207:t_028:1.en:
$$いぶき$$
「And more than one has appeared!」

207:t_028:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「With everyone positioned like this, we're the only ones who can handle the $$ヘテロダイン$$s! We have to do it!」

207:t_028:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No...! He hasn't responded for a while!」

207:t_028:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「First, we'll deal with the AS units and $$ヘテロダイン$$s! Then we'll head for $$陣代高校$$!」

207:t_028:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Wait for us, $$宗介$$...! We're coming right away!」

207:t_003:1.en:
$$甲児$$
(If you're safe, hurry up and answer...)

207:t_029:0.en:
$$一成$$
「Damn! What the hell's been going on?!」

207:t_029:2.en:
$$林水$$
(It seems you were too late, $$相良$$...)

207:t_029:5.en:
$$一成$$
「Look! There's an AS at school too!」

207:t_004:0.en:
$$クラマ$$
「$$ミスリル$$'s $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ model...! It was hiding with $$ＥＣＳ$$!」

207:t_004:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「You knew about the $$アーバレスト$$, but it seems you didn't research $$アル$$ enough!」

207:t_004:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「No need to chase him, $$レイス$$. I'm counting on you to look after $$常磐$$.」

207:t_004:5.en:
$$レイス$$
「Understood. As $$千鳥かなめ$$'s guard, I'm also responsible for failing to stop them until now.」

207:t_004:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll defeat them and protect $$千鳥$$...!」

207:t_004:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sorry I put you through that terror, $$常磐$$.」

207:t_004:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I am exactly what that man said. I can't stay at school anymore.」

207:t_004:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「But $n, $$アルト$$ and the others are different... ...They're... different from me...」

207:t_004:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「I enjoyed our days together. Thank you.」

207:t_005:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「You bastard... You had us worried!」

207:t_005:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「She's unconscious, but safe. I've moved her to shelter.」

207:t_005:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I'm sorry... Because of me, you can't go to $$陣代高校$$ anymore...」

207:t_005:5.en:
$n
「...Don't worry about it. Even if we can't attend $$陣代高校$$, we can protect everyone there.」

207:t_005:7.en:
$n
「$$陣代高校$$ is precious to me. So if I can fight to protect it, I have no regrets.」

207:t_005:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「You did well too, $$アル$$. I'm grateful.」

207:t_005:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why say something so obvious now?」

207:t_005:15.en:
$$アル$$
「A premonition that I will part with you.」

207:t_005:18.en:
$$マオ$$
「One enemy is coming your way!」

207:t_006:1.en:
$$アル$$
「I believe it has a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$. Its other specifications cannot be estimated.」

207:t_006:2.en:
???
「You're a guard dog who doesn't know when to give up.」

207:t_006:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Don't worry. I have no intention of taking the people left at school hostage.」

207:t_006:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「But if you won't give up and hand her over... you understand, don't you?」

207:t_006:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's deliberately provoking me over an external speaker...」

207:t_006:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「No reply. So you intend to keep resisting to the end.」

207:t_006:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「That stubbornness... Do you perhaps think it makes you look cool?」

207:t_006:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「You see, I rather... dislike that, $$相良宗介$$.」

207:t_006:10.en:
$$風間$$
「That AS fighting the white one over there...」

207:t_006:11.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「There's no doubt! He called out $$相良$$'s name!」

207:t_006:12.en:
$$風間$$
「Then $$相良$$ is piloting the white AS?!」

207:t_006:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...!」

207:t_007:1.en:
$$アル$$
「I surmise it is an additional capability provided by the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$.」

207:t_007:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「This one has a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$! The $$アーバレスト$$ will handle it!」

207:t_007:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「It's frustrating, but we don't have any forces to spare to support $$宗介$$ either...」
